'''Eldr'nol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stereb]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Eldr'nol lived with his Stereb tribe in the cave systems beneath the surface of Prakith, and he and his followers were responsible for fulfilling the tribe's logistical needs. In c. [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents encountered Eldr'nol on Prakith, and he showed them a map of the Prakith cave systems. When the agents eventually left, Eldr'nol was sad to see them go, but he hoped that they would find what they sought.
